description: Move a Shoot Board photo between the Clothing, Models and Locations piles. Saves the same image as the new kind and swaps it on the board; the old asset is deleted only if intake saved it in the last 24 hours and nothing uses it, otherwise it stays in the library. Asking for a move that already happened changes nothing and returns the board (status "unchanged").

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

expected_revision.description: Board revision this write is based on; a stale revision returns a revision_conflict error with the current board instead of overwriting it

to.description: The pile to move it to

name: mcp_reclassify_board_item
title: Move Photo to Another Pile
